questions.prompt: How should deletion handle a node with two children in this approach?

choices.label: Delete both child subtrees with the node.
choices.feedback: Removing the copied successor avoids leaving a duplicate while preserving BST order.

choices.label: Copy its successor but leave the original successor in place.
choices.feedback: Removing the copied successor avoids leaving a duplicate while preserving BST order.

choices.label: Copy its inorder successor, then delete that successor from the right subtree.
choices.feedback: Removing the copied successor avoids leaving a duplicate while preserving BST order.
